# Twitch Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that reads and writes your Twitch channel through the Helix API: channel profile, follower count, live stream status and viewers, past broadcasts and clips, plus channel title/game updates and clip creation (confirmed first). Connects via OAuth — self-serve in the Twitch Developer Console with no review gate (your Twitch account needs 2FA enabled). No secrets in the repo — credentials stay in Muse's secure vault.
